Every card says “not on your planner yet” — that is what the old “waiting” label meant. Only number 2 was ever on your live planner, and it was broken; the other eleven are new and still waiting to be published.

Card numbers never change — say 4 is wrong and I will know exactly which.

1

Outdent no longer hides the branch

not on your planner yet

"when I edit indent backward it removes the visual of the branch it’s from"

was wrong

A rule files any dated, titled, top-level item with no children into “Unbranched”, which is folded. Outdent a branch’s last child and the branch matched that shape.

now

The branch stays put. Guarded by shape, so deleting the last child is covered too.

2

Backspace really clears a date

not on your planner yet

"number two is not working"

was wrong

You were right. A native date field only responds once an mm/dd/yyyy segment is selected, so pressing Backspace at the field did nothing. My check never caught it because it assigned the empty value instead of typing it — it proved the save path, not that a person can clear one.

now

Backspace and Delete clear the field outright, in the Edit dialog and on a tree row. Re-tested with real keystrokes: fails on the live build, passes now, and it is a push gate.
